AcfNaAction#summary.en: Policy for missing observations in a time series.
AcfNaAction#summary.ja: 時系列の欠損観測値に対する処理方針です。

AcfOptions#summary.en: Options for autocorrelation and autocovariance. Equivalent to the arguments of R's stats::acf().
AcfOptions#summary.ja: 自己相関と自己共分散のオプションです。R の stats::acf() の引数と同等です。

AcfOptions.ci#summary.en: Confidence level used for the white-noise bounds.
AcfOptions.ci#summary.ja: 白色雑音の境界に使用する信頼水準です。

AcfOptions.demean#summary.en: Whether to subtract the series mean before computing products.
AcfOptions.demean#summary.ja: 積を計算する前に系列の平均を差し引くかどうかです。

AcfOptions.lagMax#summary.en: Maximum non-negative lag to return, in observation units.
AcfOptions.lagMax#summary.ja: 返すラグの最大値です (非負の値で、観測単位)。

AcfOptions.naAction#summary.en: Whether missing values cause an error or are omitted pairwise.
AcfOptions.naAction#summary.ja: 欠損値がエラーの原因となるか、ペアごとに除外されるかを指定します。

AcfOptions.type#summary.en: Statistic to return: correlation, covariance or partial autocorrelation.
AcfOptions.type#summary.ja: 返す統計量です: 相関、共分散、または偏自己相関。

AcfResult#summary.en: Result of an autocorrelation, partial-autocorrelation or cross-correlation calculation.
AcfResult#summary.ja: 自己相関、偏自己相関、または相互相関の計算結果です。

AcfResult.acf#summary.en: Autocorrelation, autocovariance or partial-autocorrelation values at each lag.
AcfResult.acf#summary.ja: 各ラグにおける自己相関、自己共分散、または偏自己相関の値です。

AcfResult.clim#summary.en: White-noise confidence bound for the selected confidence level.
AcfResult.clim#summary.ja: 選択した信頼水準に対する白色雑音の信頼限界です。

AcfResult.lag#summary.en: Integer lags corresponding to the returned values.
AcfResult.lag#summary.ja: 返された値に対応する整数のラグです。

AcfResult.nUsed#summary.en: Number of observations in the input series.
AcfResult.nUsed#summary.ja: 入力系列の観測値の数です。

AcfResult.type#summary.ja: 返された統計量の種類です。

AcfType#summary.en: Kind of autocorrelation statistic returned by acf().
AcfType#summary.ja: acf() が返す自己相関統計量の種類です。

ArResult.aic#summary.en: aic minus its minimum, for orders 0..orderMax.
ArResult.aic#summary.ja: 次数 0..orderMax における aic の最小値との差です。

ArResult.xIntercept#summary.ja: 平均を差し引いた系列に対する ar.ols の切片です。

ArimaOptions#summary.ja: {@link arima} のオプションです。

ArimaOptions.fixed#summary.en: Fixed values (NaN for the free ones), in the order of the coefficients.
ArimaOptions.fixed#summary.ja: 係数の順に並べた固定値です (自由な係数は NaN)。

ArimaOptions.frequency#summary.en: The series' frequency (the seasonal period by default). Default 1.
ArimaOptions.frequency#summary.ja: 系列の頻度です (既定では季節周期)。既定は 1 です。

ArimaOptions.hessian#summary.en: "R" (default): the variance matrix from R's numerical Hessian (agrees with R); "exact": a converged Hessian.
ArimaOptions.hessian#summary.ja: "R" (既定): R の数値ヘッセ行列から得た分散行列 (R と一致します)。"exact": 収束したヘッセ行列です。

ArimaOptions.includeMean#summary.en: Include a mean (ignored when differenced). Default true.
ArimaOptions.includeMean#summary.ja: 平均を含めます (差分を取った場合は無視されます)。既定は true です。

ArimaOptions.init#summary.ja: 初期値です (NaN は既定値で補われます)。

ArimaOptions.kappa#summary.en: Prior variance multiple of the presample values in a differenced model. Default 1e6.
ArimaOptions.kappa#summary.ja: 差分モデルにおける事前標本値の事前分散の倍率です。既定は 1e6 です。

ArimaOptions.nCond#summary.en: Initial observations ignored by CSS (at least the AR lags).
ArimaOptions.nCond#summary.ja: CSS で無視する初期観測値の数です (少なくとも AR のラグ数)。

ArimaOptions.order#summary.ja: (p, d, q) です。既定は [0, 0, 0] です。

ArimaOptions.seasonal#summary.en: The seasonal part (an order, or an order and a period).
ArimaOptions.seasonal#summary.ja: 季節成分です (次数、または次数と周期)。

ArimaOptions.transformPars#summary.en: Transform the AR parameters to stationarity during the ML optimisation. Default true.
ArimaOptions.transformPars#summary.ja: ML の最適化中に AR パラメータを定常性を満たす形に変換します。既定は true です。

ArimaOptions.xreg#summary.en: Regressors: one array per regressor, each of the series' length.
ArimaOptions.xreg#summary.ja: 回帰変数です。各回帰変数につき、系列と同じ長さの配列を 1 つ指定します。

ArimaOptions.xregNames#summary.en: Names of the regressors. Default "xreg1", "xreg2", ... (or "xreg" for one).
ArimaOptions.xregNames#summary.ja: 回帰変数の名前です。既定は "xreg1", "xreg2", ... (1 つの場合は "xreg") です。

ArimaResult.aic#summary.ja: -2 loglik + 2 (自由な係数 + 1) です。CSS の場合は NaN です。

ArimaResult.arma#summary.en: (p, q, P, Q, period, d, D).
ArimaResult.arma#summary.ja: (p, q, P, Q, period, d, D) です。

ArimaResult.code#summary.ja: 最適化アルゴリズムの収束コードです (0 = 収束)。

ArimaResult.coef#summary.en: The coefficients (AR, MA, seasonal AR, seasonal MA, intercept, regressors).
ArimaResult.coef#summary.ja: 係数です (AR、MA、季節 AR、季節 MA、切片、回帰変数)。

ArimaResult.coefNames#summary.en: Their names (ar1, ma1, sar1, sma1, intercept, regressor names).
ArimaResult.coefNames#summary.ja: 係数名です (ar1、ma1、sar1、sma1、intercept、回帰変数名)。

ArimaResult.includeMean#summary.ja: 平均を含めたかどうかです。

ArimaResult.loglik#summary.en: The maximised log-likelihood of the differenced data (CSS: R's approximation).
ArimaResult.loglik#summary.ja: 差分データの最大化された対数尤度です (CSS の場合は R の近似値)。

ArimaResult.mask#summary.ja: 自由な係数を示すマスクです。

ArimaResult.model#summary.en: The state space model at the end of the series.
ArimaResult.model#summary.ja: 系列末尾における状態空間モデルです。

ArimaResult.nCond#summary.en: Initial observations not used by CSS.
ArimaResult.nCond#summary.ja: CSS で使用しなかった初期観測値の数です。

ArimaResult.nobs#summary.en: The number of observations used in the likelihood.
ArimaResult.nobs#summary.ja: 尤度の計算に使用した観測値の数です。

ArimaResult.residuals#summary.en: The fitted innovations (standardised one-step errors; NaN at missing values).
ArimaResult.residuals#summary.ja: 当てはめたイノベーション (標準化された 1 期先誤差。欠測値の位置は NaN) です。

ArimaResult.sigma2#summary.en: The MLE of the innovations variance (CSS: the mean of the squared CSS residuals).
ArimaResult.sigma2#summary.ja: イノベーション分散の最尤推定値です (CSS の場合は CSS 残差の二乗平均)。

ArimaResult.varCoef#summary.en: The variance matrix of the free coefficients (rows and columns as `coefNames` of the free ones).
ArimaResult.varCoef#summary.ja: 自由な係数の分散行列です (行と列は、自由な係数に対応する `coefNames` の順です)。

ArimaResult.xreg#summary.en: The regressors (as given), including no intercept column.
ArimaResult.xreg#summary.ja: 与えられた回帰変数です。切片の列は含みません。

ArimaSeasonal#summary.en: Seasonal part of an ARIMA model.
ArimaSeasonal#summary.ja: ARIMA モデルの季節成分です。

ArimaSeasonal.order#summary.ja: (P, D, Q) です。既定は [0, 0, 0] です。

ArimaSeasonal.period#summary.en: The period. Default the series' frequency.
ArimaSeasonal.period#summary.ja: 周期です。既定は系列の頻度です。

ArimaStateModel#summary.en: The state space model behind a fit, for forecasting.
ArimaStateModel#summary.ja: 当てはめの背後にある、予測に使用する状態空間モデルです。

ArimaStateModel.a#summary.en: Filtered state and covariance at the end of the series (in units of sigma2).
ArimaStateModel.a#summary.ja: 系列末尾におけるフィルタ済み状態と共分散です (sigma2 単位)。

AutoArimaOptions#summary.ja: {@link autoArima} のオプションです。

AutoArimaOptions.approximation#summary.en: Rank the models by their CSS fits (default: n > 150 or frequency > 12), then refit the best without it.
AutoArimaOptions.approximation#summary.ja: CSS による当てはめでモデルを順位付けします (既定: n > 150 または frequency > 12)。その後、最良のモデルを近似なしで再当てはめします。

AutoArimaResult#summary.en: Result of {@link autoArima}: the chosen model's fit and the search.
AutoArimaResult#summary.ja: {@link autoArima} の結果です。選択されたモデルの当てはめと探索結果を含みます。

AutoArimaTraceEntry#summary.en: One model of the search (forecast's trace).
AutoArimaTraceEntry#summary.ja: 探索対象となった 1 つのモデルです (forecast の trace)。

AutoArimaTraceEntry.ic#summary.en: The criterion (Infinity for a rejected or failed fit; the CSS fit's value with approximation).
AutoArimaTraceEntry.ic#summary.ja: 情報量規準です (棄却または当てはめに失敗した場合は Infinity。近似を使った場合は CSS 当てはめの値)。

CcfOptions#summary.en: Options for cross-correlation and cross-covariance. Equivalent to the arguments of R's stats::ccf().
CcfOptions#summary.ja: 相互相関と相互共分散のオプションです。R の stats::ccf() の引数と同等です。

CcfOptions.ci#summary.en: Confidence level used for the white-noise bounds.
CcfOptions.ci#summary.ja: 白色雑音の境界に使用する信頼水準です。

CcfOptions.demean#summary.en: Whether to subtract each series mean before computing products.
CcfOptions.demean#summary.ja: 積を計算する前に各系列の平均を差し引くかどうかです。

CcfOptions.lagMax#summary.en: Maximum absolute lag to return, in observation units.
CcfOptions.lagMax#summary.ja: 返すラグの絶対値の最大値です (観測単位)。

CcfOptions.naAction#summary.en: Whether missing values cause an error or are omitted pairwise.
CcfOptions.naAction#summary.ja: 欠損値がエラーの原因となるか、ペアごとに除外されるかを指定します。

CcfOptions.type#summary.en: Statistic to return: correlation or covariance.
CcfOptions.type#summary.ja: 返す統計量です: 相関または共分散。

EtsOptions#summary.ja: {@link ets} のオプションです。

EtsOptions.damped#summary.en: true / false, or undefined to try both when the trend is chosen.
EtsOptions.damped#summary.ja: true / false、または trend が選択されたときに両方を試す場合は undefined です。

EtsOptions.model#summary.en: Three letters (error, trend, season) of A, M, N and Z (chosen); default "ZZZ".
EtsOptions.model#summary.ja: 誤差、トレンド、季節成分を表す 3 文字です。各文字は A、M、N、Z (選択) のいずれかで、既定は "ZZZ" です。

EtsOptions.optCrit#summary.en: The estimation criterion: the likelihood (default) or the mean squared one-step error.
EtsOptions.optCrit#summary.ja: 推定規準です。尤度 (既定) または 1 期先誤差の平均二乗です。

EtsParameters#summary.en: Parameters and initial states in R's order: alpha, beta, gamma, phi, l, b, s0 .. s_{m-2} (s0 the most recent).
EtsParameters#summary.ja: R と同じ順序のパラメータと初期状態です: alpha、beta、gamma、phi、l、b、s0 .. s_{m-2} (s0 が最も新しい値)。

EtsResult.nParams#summary.en: Number of estimated parameters (smoothing parameters and initial states).
EtsResult.nParams#summary.ja: 推定したパラメータ (平滑化パラメータと初期状態) の数です。

EtsSpec#summary.ja: 完全に指定された ETS モデルです。

ForecastArimaOptions#summary.ja: {@link forecastArima} のオプションです。

ForecastArimaOptions.lambda#summary.en: A Box-Cox lambda, or "auto" for {@link boxCoxLambda}.
ForecastArimaOptions.lambda#summary.ja: Box-Cox の lambda、または {@link boxCoxLambda} を使う場合は "auto" です。

ForecastArimaResult#summary.en: Result of {@link forecastArima}: stats' fit plus forecast's quantities.

ForecastArimaResult.drift#summary.en: Whether a drift column was added (the last regressor).

ForecastArimaResult.fitted#summary.en: Fitted values on the original scale.

ForecastArimaResult.series#summary.en: The series on the original scale.

ForecastArimaResult.sigma2#summary.en: forecast's innovations variance: sum of squared residuals / (nobs - number of coefficients).

ForecastArimaResult.sigma2Mle#summary.en: stats' MLE of the innovations variance.

ForecastResult.se#summary.en: Forecast standard errors on the transformed scale (where analytic).

HoltWintersOptions.alpha#summary.en: Given, or estimated when undefined; `false` for beta / gamma leaves that component out.

HoltWintersResult.fitted#summary.en: One-step fitted values from the first fitted time (R's fitted xhat).

HoltWintersResult.start#summary.en: The time index (0-based) of the first fitted value.

MstlResult.seasonal#summary.en: The seasonal component (absent for a non-seasonal series).

PacfOptions#summary.en: Options for partial autocorrelation. Equivalent to the arguments of R's stats::pacf().
PacfOptions#summary.ja: 偏自己相関のオプションです。R の stats::pacf() の引数と同等です。

PacfOptions.lagMax#summary.en: Maximum positive lag to return, in observation units.
PacfOptions.lagMax#summary.ja: 返す正のラグの最大値です (観測単位)。

PacfOptions.naAction#summary.en: Whether missing values cause an error or are omitted pairwise.
PacfOptions.naAction#summary.ja: 欠損値がエラーの原因となるか、ペアごとに除外されるかを指定します。

SimpleForecast#summary.en: A forecast with intervals and the in-sample fit.

SimpleForecast.model#summary.en: The ets model behind ses / holt / hw / stlf.

StlOptions.sWindow#summary.en: The seasonal loess span (odd, >= 7 recommended) or "periodic".

StlResult.weights#summary.en: The robustness weights of the last pass (all 1 without robustness iterations).

StlResult.win#summary.en: The windows (s, t, l), degrees, jumps and iteration counts used.

StlmResult.fitted#summary.en: The in-sample fit on the original scale.

StlmResult.model#summary.en: The model of the seasonally adjusted series.

StlmResult.stl#summary.en: The decomposition of the (Box-Cox transformed) series.

TseriesTest#summary.en: A test result of the tseries functions.

TslmResult.forecast#summary.en: Forecasts with t intervals from the regression.

accuracy#summary.en:
Accuracy measures (forecast's `accuracy()`): ME, RMSE, MAE, MPE, MAPE, MASE (scaled by the training data's mean
|y_t - y_{t-m}|), ACF1 of the errors; for a test set also Theil's U.
Equivalent to `forecast::accuracy()` in R.

acf#summary.en:
Computes autocorrelation, autocovariance or partial autocorrelation of a univariate series.
Equivalent to R's `stats::acf()`.
acf#summary.ja:
単変量時系列の自己相関、自己共分散、または偏自己相関を計算します。
R の `stats::acf()` と同等です。

adfTest#summary.en:
The augmented Dickey-Fuller test (tseries' `adf.test()`): Delta y_t on 1, t, y_{t-1} and k lagged differences
(default k = trunc((n - 1)^(1/3))), the t value of y_{t-1}; p from Fuller's tau_tau table at n - 1 (clamped to
[0.01, 0.99]); "explosive" gives 1 - p.
Equivalent to `tseries::adf.test()` in R.

ar#summary.en:
Fits an autoregressive model with the order chosen by AIC (stats' `ar()`): Yule-Walker (default), Burg, OLS or MLE
(arima0 for each order).
Equivalent to R's `ar()`.

arima#summary.en:
Fits an ARIMA model by exact maximum likelihood (Kalman filter) or conditional sum of squares. Equivalent to R's
`arima()`. The estimates are taken to the optimum, where R's optimiser may stop slightly short.

arima0#summary.en:
stats' `arima0()`: an ARIMA model by maximum likelihood of the differenced series (no diffuse prior; the mean with
`includeMean` when d + D = 0), with R's fast recursions once the prediction variance is within `delta` of its limit
(default 0.01, as R; a negative delta gives the exact likelihood, equal to arima's). Log 84, 87.
Equivalent to R's `arima0()`.

arimaorder#summary.en: The (p, d, q) or (p, d, q, P, D, Q, frequency) of an ARIMA fit (forecast's `arimaorder()`). Equivalent to `forecast::arimaorder()` in R.

autoArima#summary.en:
Chooses and fits an ARIMA model by forecast's `auto.arima()` rules: d by {@link ndiffs} (after the seasonal
differences), D by {@link nsdiffs}, then the stepwise search on the AICc (or all models up to maxOrder with
`stepwise: false`).
Equivalent to `forecast::auto.arima()` in R.

With approximation, models are ranked by the CSS fits' AICc; R's printed trace adds a constant per series whose origin
is not known (it does not change the choice), so the trace values here are the CSS AICc themselves.

bizdays#summary.en:
Trading days in each month or quarter (forecast's `bizdays()`): weekdays minus the holidays of the financial centre
("New York" (NYSE, default), "London", "NERC", "Toronto", "Zurich"; the rules of log 30-32).
Equivalent to `forecast::bizdays()` in R.

boxCox#summary.en:
The Box-Cox transformation: log(x) for lambda = 0, (sign(x) |x|^lambda - 1) / lambda otherwise. Equivalent to
`forecast::BoxCox()` in R.

boxCoxLambda#summary.en:
Chooses the Box-Cox lambda by Guerrero's method (default) or the profile log-likelihood. Equivalent to
`forecast::BoxCox.lambda()` in R.

boxTest#summary.en:
Box-Pierce or Ljung-Box test of white noise (stats' `Box.test()`): r_k the autocorrelations (mean removed, divided by
n), Q = n sum r_k^2 or n (n + 2) sum r_k^2 / (n - k), chi-squared on lag - fitdf degrees of freedom.
Equivalent to R's `Box.test()`.

ccf#summary.en:
Computes cross-correlation or cross-covariance of two equal-length series. Lag k pairs x[t+k] with y[t].
Equivalent to R's `stats::ccf()`.
ccf#summary.ja:
長さが等しい 2 つの時系列の相互相関または相互共分散を計算します。ラグ k では x[t+k] と y[t] を組み合わせます。
R の `stats::ccf()` と同等です。

checkresiduals#summary.en:
The Ljung-Box test of a model's residuals (forecast's `checkresiduals()`, without the plots): lag = min(2m, n/5) for
seasonal data or min(10, n/5), at least df + 3, df = the number of ARMA coefficients (0 for plain residuals).
Equivalent to `forecast::checkresiduals()` in R.

croston#summary.en:
Croston's method for intermittent demand (forecast's `croston()`): SES with alpha on the non-zero demands and on the
intervals between them (counted from time 0), each started at its first value; forecast k z / p with k = 1 (croston),
1 - alpha/2 (sba) or 1 - alpha/(2 - alpha) (sbj). No intervals. Departs from R when the last observation is a
demand: R's forecast is the state before it (the last fitted value, the last observation unused; log 91), rStats.js
forecasts from the state after it.
Equivalent to `forecast::croston()` in R.

cvLm#summary.en:
Cross-validation and information criteria of a linear model (forecast's `CV()`): CV = mean((e / (1 - h_ii))^2), AIC =
n log(SSE/n) + 2(k + 2), AICc, BIC, adjusted R^2 (k = the number of predictors).
Equivalent to `forecast::CV()` in R.

decompose#summary.en:
Classical seasonal decomposition by moving averages (stats' `decompose()`). `start` is the position (1..frequency)
of the first observation in the cycle; `figure` starts at that position, as R's.
Equivalent to R's `decompose()`.

diffinv#summary.en:
The inverse of differencing (stats' `diffinv()`): the cumulative sums at the given lag, repeated `differences`
times, starting from `xi` (zeros by default).
Equivalent to R's `diffinv()`.

dmTest#summary.en:
The Diebold-Mariano test with the Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction (forecast's `dm.test()`): d = |e1|^power -
|e2|^power, its variance from the autocovariances up to h - 1 (over n), t(n - 1).
Equivalent to `forecast::dm.test()` in R.

easter#summary.en:
The Easter holidays in each month or quarter (forecast's `easter()`): the share of Good Friday .. Easter Sunday (..
Monday with `easterMon`) falling in the period, rounded to two decimals (as R). Departs from R for quarterly data
with `easterMon` when the holidays span two quarters: R's shares are shifted there (it warns about a replacement
length; log 91), rStats.js gives each quarter its share.
Equivalent to `forecast::easter()` in R.

easterSunday#summary.en: Easter Sunday of year Y (anonymous Gregorian algorithm) as [month, day]. Not an R function.

ets#summary.en:
Exponential smoothing state space model (forecast's `ets()`): one model, or the smallest information criterion
among the allowed models for the letters given as "Z". The parameters are estimated to the optimum of the
likelihood within the usual bounds and the admissible region (R's optimiser can stop earlier).
Equivalent to `forecast::ets()` in R.

findfrequency#summary.en:
The dominant period of a series (forecast's `findfrequency()`): 1 unless the maximum of the AR spectrum of the
detrended series exceeds 10; then round(1 / f) at the maximum, or, when the maximum is at the lowest frequency, at
the largest value after the spectrum first rises (1 if that is the last frequency).
Equivalent to `forecast::findfrequency()` in R.

forecast#summary.en:
Forecasts from a series or a fitted model (forecast's `forecast()`):
- a series (`frequency` in the options): ets, or stlf when the period is 13 or more and the series is longer than
  two periods (forecast's help; log 93);
- an {@link ets} fit, a {@link forecastArima} / {@link autoArima} fit, a stats {@link arima} fit (with its MLE
  innovations variance), an {@link stlm} fit, a {@link holtWinters} fit (stats' prediction intervals) or an
  {@link ar} fit (normal intervals from the prediction standard errors).
`h` defaults to twice the period for seasonal data, else 10.
Equivalent to `forecast::forecast()` in R.

forecastArima#summary.en:
Fits an ARIMA model as forecast's `Arima()`: stats' arima on the Box-Cox transformed series, with a drift, and
forecast's innovations variance, AICc and BIC.
Equivalent to `forecast::Arima()` in R.

forecastEts#summary.en:
Point forecasts and prediction intervals from an {@link ets} fit (forecast's `forecast.ets()`): the analytic
variances of classes 1 and 2, the exact moments of class 3 (MNM, MAM, MAdM), and simulation otherwise (npaths
paths with rStats.js's R-compatible generator, seeded by `seed`). Two departures from R's forecast.ets (the
model's formulas are used): damped class 3 forecasts use l + phi b at h = 1, and ANA / MNA put the seasonal term
of c_j at j mod m = 0.
Equivalent to `forecast::forecast()` in R.

forecastFromArima#summary.en:
Point forecasts and prediction intervals from a {@link forecastArima} fit (forecast's `forecast.Arima()`).
Equivalent to `forecast::forecast()` in R.

forecastStlm#summary.en:
Forecasts from an {@link stlm} fit (forecast's `forecast.stlm()`): the model's forecasts of the seasonally adjusted
series plus the last cycle of the seasonal component, back-transformed with the fit's lambda.
Equivalent to `forecast::forecast()` in R.

fourier#summary.en:
Fourier terms (forecast's `fourier()`): S_k = sin(2 pi k t / m), C_k = cos(2 pi k t / m) for k = 1..K, t = 1..n (or
n + 1..n + h), the sine dropped at k = m / 2; columns named "S1-12", "C1-12", ...
Equivalent to `forecast::fourier()` in R.

holt#summary.en:
Holt's linear trend method (forecast's `holt()`): ets AAN (AAdN damped, MMN exponential); `initial: "simple"`
starts at l = y_1, b = y_2 - y_1.
Equivalent to `forecast::holt()` in R.

holtWinters#summary.en:
Holt-Winters filtering (stats' `HoltWinters()`): exponential smoothing with optional trend and seasonal components,
the start values from decompose() of the first start.periods periods, the parameters minimising the SSE.
Equivalent to R's `HoltWinters()`.

hw#summary.en:
Holt-Winters seasonal method (forecast's `hw()`): ets AAA or MAM (damped: AAdA, MAdM); `initial: "simple"` starts at
l = mean(y[1:m]), b = (mean(y[m+1:2m]) - mean(y[1:m]))/m, s = y[1:m] - l (or / l).
Equivalent to `forecast::hw()` in R.

invBoxCox#summary.en:
The inverse Box-Cox transformation (sign-preserving where lambda z + 1 < 0), with forecast's bias adjustment when
`fvar` (the forecast variances on the transformed scale) is given and `biasadj` is true. Equivalent to
`forecast::InvBoxCox()` in R.

jarqueBeraTest#summary.en:
The Jarque-Bera test for normality (tseries' `jarque.bera.test()`): n (S^2/6 + (K - 3)^2/24) with the moments over n,
chi-squared with 2 df.
Equivalent to `tseries::jarque.bera.test()` in R.

kpssPValue#summary.en: The KPSS table's p-value, linear in the statistic between the 10%, 5%, 2.5%, 1% points, clamped to [0.01, 0.10]. Not an R function.

kpssStatistic#summary.en: The KPSS statistic with a given truncation lag (residuals on 1, or on 1 and t). Not an R function.

kpssTest#summary.en:
The KPSS test (tseries' `kpss.test()`): the null "Level" or "Trend", truncation lag trunc(4 (n/100)^0.25) (`lshort`)
or trunc(12 (n/100)^0.25); p interpolated in the KPSS table (clamped to [0.01, 0.10]).
Equivalent to `tseries::kpss.test()` in R.

ma#summary.en: Moving-average smoother (forecast's `ma()`): order k, centred (a 2 x k average) for even k when `centre`. Equivalent to `forecast::ma()` in R.

meanf#summary.en:
Forecasts by the mean (forecast's `meanf()`): intervals mean +- qt(level, n - 1) sd(y) sqrt(1 + 1/n).
Equivalent to `forecast::meanf()` in R.

minRootModulus#summary.en: The roots' smallest modulus of 1 + c_1 z + ... + c_k z^k (Infinity for a constant). Not an R function.

monthdays#summary.en: Days in each month or quarter (forecast's `monthdays()`). Equivalent to `forecast::monthdays()` in R.

mstl#summary.en:
forecast's `mstl()` for one seasonal period: stl(x, s.window = 11); for a non-seasonal series (or fewer than two
periods) the trend is supsmu(1:n, x).
Equivalent to `forecast::mstl()` in R.

naInterp#summary.en:
Interpolation of missing values (forecast's `na.interp()`): linear for non-seasonal series (or at most two periods
observed); for seasonal series the seasonal component of a robust mstl of a first filling (lm on Fourier terms K =
min(5, floor(m/2)) and a polynomial of degree min(6, floor(n/10))), the seasonally adjusted series interpolated
linearly.
Equivalent to `forecast::na.interp()` in R.

naive#summary.en: Naive forecasts (forecast's `naive()`): {@link rwf} without a drift. Equivalent to `forecast::naive()` in R.

ndiffs#summary.en: The number of first differences needed for stationarity by a unit root test. Equivalent to `forecast::ndiffs()` in R.

nsdiffs#summary.en:
The number of seasonal differences: 1 when the seasonal strength of mstl, max(0, 1 - var(remainder) /
var(seasonal + remainder)), exceeds 0.64 (test "seas"), or by the OCSB test. Equivalent to `forecast::nsdiffs()` in R.

ocsbCritical#summary.en: The 5% critical value of the OCSB test for period m (the table read off R; log m interpolation beyond 400). Not an R function.

ocsbTest#summary.en:
The Osborn-Chui-Smith-Birchenhall test for a seasonal unit root: with w = Delta_m Delta_1 y and L lags, the AR(L)
coefficients a of w by least squares (no mean), then the regression of w_t on w_{t-1..L} and the two auxiliary
series filtered by a, (1 - a(B)) Delta_m y_{t-1} and (1 - a(B)) Delta_1 y_{t-m}, without a constant; the statistic
is the t value of the second (log 41, 80). Equivalent to `forecast::ocsb.test()` in R. With `lagMethod` "fixed" (the
default) L = `maxlag` (R's default 0). With "AIC", "BIC" or "AICc" the lags 0..maxlag are compared on a common
sample (the rows of maxlag lags, the prefilter too) by the lm criterion with k = coefficients + 1 (AICc = AIC +
2k(k + 1) / (n - k - 1), forecast's help), and the chosen L is used. **This departs from R:** forecast 9.0.2 compares
L = 1..maxlag that way but reports and uses one lag fewer than the chosen L (log 89-90, an off-by-one; the user's
decision 2026-11-27 is not to imitate it). Candidates with a perfect fit (and for AICc, n <= k + 1) are skipped.

pacf#summary.en:
Computes partial autocorrelation of a univariate series with the Durbin–Levinson recursion.
Equivalent to R's `stats::pacf()`.
pacf#summary.ja:
Durbin–Levinson の再帰計算により、単変量時系列の偏自己相関を計算します。
R の `stats::pacf()` と同等です。

poTest#summary.en:
The Phillips-Ouliaris cointegration test (tseries' `po.test()`): x has 2 to 6 columns (variables) as rows of
observations; u = the residuals of the first column on the others (with an intercept when `demean`, default),
Z = (n - 1)(rho - 1) - (lambda^2 - s^2) / (2 sum u_{t-1}^2 / (n - 1)^2) from u_t on u_{t-1}; lag trunc((n - 1)/100)
(`lshort`) or trunc((n - 1)/30); p from Table Ib / Ia (clamped to [0.01, 0.15]).
Equivalent to `tseries::po.test()` in R.

ppTest#summary.en:
The Phillips-Perron test (tseries' `pp.test()`): y_t on 1, t, y_{t-1}; Phillips and Perron's closed forms with
det(X'X) (log 8), type "Z(alpha)" (default, as R) or "Z(t_alpha)", truncation lag trunc(4 (n/100)^0.25) (`lshort`)
or trunc(12 (n/100)^0.25); p from Fuller's n(rho - 1) or tau_tau table at n - 1; "explosive" gives 1 - p.
Equivalent to `tseries::pp.test()` in R.

predictAr#summary.en: Predictions from an {@link ar} fit (stats' `predict.ar`): the AR recursion about the mean, se = sqrt(var.pred cumsum(psi^2)). Equivalent to R's `predict()`.

predictArima#summary.en:
Forecasts from an {@link arima} fit by the Kalman filter (the exact predictor from the finite past). Equivalent to
R's `predict.Arima()`.

predictHoltWinters#summary.en:
Predictions from a {@link holtWinters} fit with intervals (stats' `predict.HoltWinters()`): additive and
non-seasonal models var(residuals) (1 + sum_{j<h} psi_j^2), psi_j = alpha (1 + j beta) + gamma (1 - alpha) [j mod f
= 0]; multiplicative models var(residuals) sum_{j=0}^{h-1} (psi_j s_h / s_{h-j})^2 with cyclic seasonal indices
(R reads the seasonal factors at fixed positions of its coefficient vector instead: R bug 19369; equal for h < f with
a trend).
Equivalent to R's `predict()`.

remainder#summary.en: The remainder component of an {@link mstl} decomposition (forecast's `remainder()`). Equivalent to `forecast::remainder()` in R.

runsTest#summary.en:
The Wald-Wolfowitz runs test (tseries' `runs.test()`) of a two-valued sequence: z = (R - mean) / sd with mean 1 +
2 n1 n2 / n and variance 2 n1 n2 (2 n1 n2 - n) / (n^2 (n - 1)), normal p for "two.sided" (default), "less" or
"greater".
Equivalent to `tseries::runs.test()` in R.

rwf#summary.en:
Random walk forecasts (forecast's `rwf()`), with a drift (y_n - y_1)/(n - 1) when `drift`. sigma = sqrt(mean(res^2))
without a drift, sd(res) with one; se_h = sigma sqrt(h) or sigma sqrt(h (1 + h/(n - 1))).
Equivalent to `forecast::rwf()` in R.

seasadj#summary.en: The seasonally adjusted series of an mstl / stl decomposition (data - seasonal). Equivalent to `forecast::seasadj()` in R.

seasonalComponent#summary.en: The seasonal component of an {@link mstl} decomposition (forecast's `seasonal()`; zeros without one). Equivalent to `forecast::seasonal()` in R.

seasonaldummy#summary.en: Seasonal dummies (forecast's `seasonaldummy()`): m - 1 columns, the last period omitted; `start` the cycle position (1-based) of the first row. Equivalent to `forecast::seasonaldummy()` in R.

ses#summary.en:
Simple exponential smoothing (forecast's `ses()`): ets(y, "ANN"), or with `initial: "simple"` the level started at
y_1 and alpha minimising the one-step SSE.
Equivalent to `forecast::ses()` in R.

snaive#summary.en: Seasonal naive forecasts (forecast's `snaive()`): y_{n - m + ...}, se_h = sigma sqrt(floor((h - 1)/m) + 1). Equivalent to `forecast::snaive()` in R.

specAr#summary.en: The AR spectrum (stats' `spec.ar()` at n.freq frequencies 0..0.5) of x: var.pred / |1 - sum a_k e^{-2 pi i f k}|^2. Equivalent to R's `spec.ar()`.

stl#summary.en:
Seasonal-trend decomposition by loess (Cleveland et al. 1990). Equivalent to R's `stl()`. It differs in that the
robustness weights use the true median of |remainder| (R takes a wrong order statistic for some even-length series:
R bug 19370, see the documentation's departures from R).

stlf#summary.en:
STL + ETS forecasts (forecast's `stlf()`): mstl(y), forecast(ets(seasonally adjusted, "ZZN")), plus the last cycle of
the seasonal component repeated.
Equivalent to `forecast::stlf()` in R.

stlm#summary.en:
STL decomposition with a model of the seasonally adjusted series (forecast's `stlm()`): mstl of the series (Box-Cox
transformed with `lambda`), then `ets(adjusted, etsModel)` (default "ZZN") or, with `method: "arima"`,
`auto.arima(adjusted, seasonal = FALSE)` (log 93: R's model has no seasonal part).
Equivalent to `forecast::stlm()` in R.

supsmu#summary.en:
Friedman's super smoother (running lines with a cross-validated variable span). Equivalent to R's `supsmu()`.
Tied x are not handled as R does.

terasvirtaTest#summary.en:
Teraesvirta's neural network test for neglected nonlinearity (tseries' `terasvirta.test()`): y_t on 1 and its lags,
then also on the second and third order products of the lags; Chisq = n log(SSR0 / SSR1) (n the series length) or
F on (df, n - lag - df) (log 14). The series is standardised when `scale` (default).
Equivalent to `tseries::terasvirta.test()` in R.

thetaf#summary.en:
The theta method (forecast's `thetaf()`): a seasonality test |r_m| > qnorm(0.95) sqrt((1 + 2 sum_{i<m} r_i^2)/n), a
multiplicative decompose when seasonal, ses by MSE, mean = ses mean + b/2 (h - 1 + 1/alpha - (1 - alpha)^n / alpha)
with b the slope of lm(y ~ t), reseasonalised. Departs from R when seasonal: the interval bounds are reseasonalised
(R adds the adjusted-scale width to the reseasonalised mean) and the residuals are y - fitted (R's are on the
adjusted scale); the user's decision, log 91-92.
Equivalent to `forecast::thetaf()` in R.

trendcycle#summary.en: The trend-cycle component of an {@link mstl} decomposition (forecast's `trendcycle()`). Equivalent to `forecast::trendcycle()` in R.

tsCV#summary.en:
Time series cross-validation (forecast's `tsCV()`): for each origin t the forecast errors of y_{t+1..t+h} from the fit
to y_1..y_t, stored in row t (NaN where unavailable).
Equivalent to `forecast::tsCV()` in R.

tsFilter#summary.en:
Linear filtering of a series (stats' `filter()`): convolution, y_i = sum_j f_j x_{i + o - (j - 1)} with o = 0 for
`sides: 1` and floor(p / 2) for `sides: 2` (NaN where an index falls outside, or wrapped with `circular`), or
recursive, y_i = x_i + sum_j f_j y_{i - j} with `init` (the most recent value first, as R).
Equivalent to R's `filter()`.

tsclean#summary.en:
The series with missing values interpolated and outliers replaced (forecast's `tsclean()`).
Equivalent to `forecast::tsclean()` in R.

tslm#summary.en:
Linear regression on a trend (1..n) and seasonal dummies (forecast's `tslm(y ~ trend + season)`), the first season
the baseline.
Equivalent to `forecast::tslm()` in R.

tsoutliers#summary.en:
Outliers and their replacements (forecast's `tsoutliers()`): the remainder of seasadj(robust mstl) minus supsmu (or x
minus supsmu), points outside [Q1 - 3 IQR, Q3 + 3 IQR], replaced by na.interp with them removed; `iterate` passes
(default 2), the union of the flags.
Equivalent to `forecast::tsoutliers()` in R.

whiteTest#summary.en:
White's neural network test for neglected nonlinearity (tseries' `white.test()`): q logistic hidden units with
weights runif((lag + 1) q, -range/2, range/2) (by columns, the first row on the constant), their principal components
2..qstar + 1 (standardised), then the statistic as {@link terasvirtaTest} (log 15). The weights come from rStats.js's
R-compatible generator: with `seed` (R's `set.seed`) the value equals R's; without, the current stream is used.
Equivalent to `tseries::white.test()` in R.
